source.morphism: run_collect : CollectRequest -> CollectResult; _resolve_workflow_mode selects legacy or WorkflowRoutingAdapter

retained: legacy adapter result shape and display_meta projection
safe default to legacy mode when INGEST_WORKFLOW_ADAPTER is absent or unrecognized
lost: typed execution authority, idempotency, attempt identity and cancellation are not part of the legacy request or routing morphism
workflow mode does not provide a distinct successor interpreter; it delegates to the same process-local adapter registry
provider receipts and authoritative readback are not guaranteed by the route boundary

affected_callers.impact: HTTP sync/async ingest callers observe legacy CollectResult semantics regardless of workflow switch
Celery callers consume raw/counter fallbacks instead of a typed execution receipt

items.alternative_path: successor typed collect execution interpreter with explicit project/capability binding, runtime attempt identity and legacy rollback flag

witness.asserts: successor routing invokes the typed C3 interpreter in input order
a missing effect gateway is OutcomeUnknown and does not fall back to legacy routing

items.decision_basis: Successor routing now invokes a typed C3 interpreter and fails to OutcomeUnknown when its effect gateway is absent, without silently using the legacy registry.

source_morphism.name: ordered terms to batch execution and fold

retained: cleaned query-term membership and deterministic input-index order
per-batch limit calculation and requested/effective parallelism diagnostics
serial execution order and parallel completion re-sorting by input index
lost: parallel effect completion is not proven commutative and shared provider/database/resource effects may interleave
default child exceptions are converted to failed children while the aggregate remains top-level completed
durable cancellation, deadline, concurrency-key reservation and replay identity are absent

affected_callers.impact: market and policy requests meeting the batch threshold execute through the lossy aggregate path
the fixture codifies partial child failure with status=completed, so callers can mistake partial collection for full completion

items.alternative_path: successor typed TraverseOrdered plan with explicit resource/failure policy and partial/cancelled outcomes

witness.asserts: a partial ordered traversal is projected as partial rather than completed

items.decision_basis: The successor ordered traversal makes partial and fail-fast cancellation visible, preserves receipts, and requires an explicit effect-independence policy before parallel effects are selected.

source_morphism.name: ordered child results to aggregate CollectResult

retained: inserted/updated/skipped totals and stable-first link/job-id deduplication
raw per-batch metadata, provider type/status/job id and attempt count when supplied
lost: mixed child failures are counted but top-level status is initialized to completed
heterogeneous errors and optional provider fields do not form a typed durable receipt union
multiple batch receipts collapse into singular top-level fields while full detail remains only in nested raw metadata

affected_callers.impact: callers return meta.raw or numeric fallback, dropping the distinction between partial and complete collection
fold output is reused to build terminal, authority and compatibility projections with separate ownership

items.alternative_path: successor typed ordered receipt fold with Succeeded/Partial/Failed aggregates and explicit receipt_kind

witness.asserts: ordered typed outcomes are passed to the C3 successor fold
mixed outcome aggregates do not project as completed

items.decision_basis: The successor C3 fold exposes ordered Succeeded, Partial, and Failed aggregates; legacy CollectResult remains only an explicit compatibility projection.

source_morphism.name: admitted source observations to terminal/frontdoor/authority/compat read models

source.morphism: to_source_library_response : admitted source observations -> terminal/frontdoor/authority/compat read models

retained: versioned terminal status, normalized request, records, statistics, errors and provider handoff observations
deprecated legacy_result payload available for bounded compatibility callers
projector output is rebuildable from admitted source revision and digest
lost: legacy raw_snapshot and inferred mode/statistics are not canonical source facts
compat_projection cannot preserve legacy write/admission authority or nondeterministic postprocess side effects
full legacy payload identity is retained only as a compatibility snapshot, not as successor canonical state

affected_callers.impact: API callers receive terminal, frontdoor, authority and compat projections together
legacy_result and compat_projection remain available as read-only compatibility observations

items.alternative_path: pure versioned C2.4 read-only projector with explicit loss_profile_ref; canonical admission remains a separate ingest operation

witness.asserts: loss profile and zero authority are explicit
rollback changes read routing without rewriting projection rows

items.decision_basis: This is an intentionally read-only compatibility projection with an explicit loss profile and zero authority. The lost legacy authority/effect behavior is excluded by contract, while the retained observations and rebuild/rollback witnesses are concrete.

source_morphism.name: crawler dispatch acknowledgement to collect or terminal handoff

retained: provider type, provider job id, provider status, attempt count, project and spider
provider_handoff route/profile metadata in terminal and frontdoor projections
queued/accepted dispatch acknowledgement remains inspectable in nested raw metadata
lost: crawler queued/scheduled/running statuses are mapped to CollectResult.status=completed by the collect adapter
dispatch acknowledgement is not separated from authoritative provider readback or OutcomeUnknown reconciliation
legacy handoff has no durable idempotency/cancel binding that prevents duplicate dispatch during rollback

affected_callers.impact: integration callers assert queued metadata but also receive completed CollectResult status
Celery job tracking separately maps provider status while collect callers may already observe completion

items.alternative_path: typed crawler handoff with dispatch acknowledgement, authoritative readback, and job/attempt-bound retry-cancel-reconcile

witness.asserts: queued, accepted, scheduled, and running acknowledgements remain non-terminal
the injected durable store replays terminal readback across bridge instances
the source-library projection remains open until typed terminal readback

items.decision_basis: Crawler dispatch acknowledgement is now distinct from terminal readback, remains open until a typed terminal result, and is replayable through an injected durable attempt store.
